parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: **1** to **1000**. Default value: **50**.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description:
The pagination token.

- If this is your first request, do not specify this parameter.

- If more results are available, set this parameter to the **NextToken** value from the previous response to retrieve the next page.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~120468~~) operation to obtain the region ID.

parameters.name: ServiceId
parameters.description: The ID of the endpoint service.

parameters.name: ServiceName
parameters.description: The name of the endpoint service.

parameters.name: ServiceRegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the endpoint service.

parameters.name: ServiceType
parameters.description:
The type of the endpoint service.

Only **Interface** is supported. An interface endpoint allows you to use Application Load Balancers (ALBs), Classic Load Balancers (CLBs), and Network Load Balancers (NLBs) as service resources.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: A list of tags to filter resources. You can specify up to 20 tags.
